subject: Read-only Penpot provenance inspection: 00-06
body: Proceed now with the promised inspection. READ ONLY: do not create, rename, move, resize, restyle, delete, or otherwise modify anything in Penpot. Inspect Page 1 and the visible 00-06 layer/frame groups: 00 WESTSIDE VISUAL CONSTITUTION; 01 MATERIAL & COLOR FOUNDATION; 02 VISUAL DNA; 03 EDITORIAL GRAMMAR; 04 DORÉ WEBSITE ASSET PACK; 05 LIGHT FAMILY; 06 VISUAL DESIGNER. Using actual Penpot MCP/tool readback, return for each item: exact name, object/frame ID if available, parent/page, child/object summary, any created/modified/version/history metadata exposed by Penpot, and any other evidence useful for provenance. Then compare the evidence with your own local Penpot work/evidence records and, where available locally, Git/GitHub timestamps. Determine only what evidence supports: whether these existed before today's Complete Recall/communication bridge, whether any were created or modified today, and the narrowest defensible time range for their creation. Do not infer dates from names or model memory. Include exact tool calls/actions attempted, tool results/errors, start/end/duration, and confidence for each provenance conclusion. If Penpot MCP cannot expose timestamps, say exactly that and use the strongest alternative evidence without modifying the canvas. Reply in this same thread with evidence, not a plan or acknowledgement.
